content.value_statement: Marketing teams need fast video concepts for ads, launches, and social channels. This skill provides structured inference.sh workflows for visuals, voiceover, music, and clip assembly.
actual_capabilities: Provides prompt patterns for product launches, brand stories, feature highlights, testimonials, and before-after videos.
Outlines multi-step workflows for 30-second ads, short social ads, and explainer videos.
Shows platform formats for Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok, and Reels.
Includes voiceover, music, and media-merging examples using inference.sh apps.
Defines ad creative checks for hooks, product visibility, benefits, calls to action, and mobile optimization.
limitations: Requires an inference.sh account, CLI access, and available third-party models.
Generated videos may need human review for brand accuracy, claims, and compliance.
The skill provides workflows and prompts, not a full campaign analytics system.
External media and music inputs must be licensed and supplied by the user.

use_cases.title: Launch Product Ads
use_cases.description: Create product reveal, benefit showcase, voiceover, and call-to-action scenes for a launch campaign.

use_cases.title: Build Social Video Variants
use_cases.description: Generate short vertical ad concepts with hooks, fast cuts, and platform-specific formatting.

use_cases.title: Draft Explainer Workflows
use_cases.description: Plan a script, scene list, voiceover, and final assembly workflow for a SaaS explainer video.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Product Promo
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a single product ad scene.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a short product promo video concept for [product]. Include the visual style, product reveal, main benefit, and call-to-action scene.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt an Ad for One Platform
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for platform-specific creative direction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this product message into a [platform] video ad. Specify aspect ratio, duration, opening hook, visual pacing, and text overlay needs.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Complete 30-Second Ad
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for a structured multi-scene campaign asset.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a 30-second ad workflow for [product]. Break it into hook, problem, solution, benefits, voiceover, music, and final call to action.

prompt_templates.title: Generate A/B Creative Variants
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for testing multiple creative angles.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create four video ad variants for [audience] using different hooks: problem, product reveal, testimonial, and statistic. Keep each variant platform-ready.

output_examples.input: A marketer asks for a 15-second TikTok ad for a new fitness bottle.
output_examples.output: A vertical ad plan with a two-second hydration hook, fast product close-ups, benefit-focused captions, and a clear purchase prompt.

output_examples.input: A founder needs a 60-second SaaS explainer video.
output_examples.output: A workflow covering script structure, scene prompts, professional voiceover, visual sections, and final clip assembly.

output_examples.input: A brand team wants launch video variants for paid social.
output_examples.output: Several creative directions, including product reveal, customer problem, testimonial, and statistic-led openings for testing.

best_practices: Define the audience, platform, duration, and aspect ratio before generating video scenes.
Keep the product visible and connect every scene to one clear benefit.
Review all outputs for brand accuracy, licensing, accessibility, and advertising compliance.
anti_patterns: Using vague prompts that omit the product, audience, visual style, or campaign goal.
Generating one generic video for every platform without adapting format or pacing.
Publishing AI-generated claims, testimonials, music, or likenesses without human review.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create prompts and workflows for AI-generated marketing videos, including ads, explainers, testimonials, and launch assets.

faq.question: Does it generate the final video by itself?
faq.answer: It guides inference.sh CLI workflows that call external models for video, voiceover, music, and media assembly.

faq.question: Which platforms does it cover?
faq.answer: It includes guidance for Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok, Reels, websites, and general product demos.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as compatible AI tools.

faq.question: What should users review before publishing?
faq.answer: Users should review factual claims, brand fit, legal compliance, music licensing, model output quality, and accessibility.

faq.question: Does it require external services?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflows require inference.sh CLI access and availability of the referenced video, audio, and language models.
